answer: A night glassworks gives each agent a small forge, and each keeper banks one ember at dusk under a numbered glass blank. All night the keeper feeds the ember one scoop of charcoal an hour and grinds the blank to match one numbered nebula print. Each hour the keeper answers the warden with a whisper of the lens number, and the warden logs only numbers from a tended forge. At dawn a second keeper tests each lens against its print and strikes the misses. A thousand fake names need a thousand forges, each ember kept alive all night, each lens ground by hand.
